picks.title: Digital Sun delays ReVamp playtest over AI cloning concerns
picks.excerpt: Digital Sun is narrowing its early testing of ReVamp to its Discord community following fears of generative AI-enabled cloning.
picks.rationale: The Moonlighter studio is restricting its playtest because of AI cloning fears, a concrete change to how teams show unreleased builds, reported by a trade outlet.

picks.title: Nintendo Shigeru Miyamoto says even if gen-AI "were to eventually handle everything, there will always be a role left" for human designers
picks.excerpt: Super Mario and The Legend of Zelda's legendary designer shared some thoughts on the rise of generative AI in games.
picks.rationale: Nintendo's best-known designer gives his first on-record view of gen AI and the human designer's role. This is new, and no Nintendo-leadership AI statement appears in 30-day history.

picks.title: Still mad at Valve for Steam's AI disclosures, Epic Games boss criticizes "forcing developers to write a political statement to be used against them by the hate mob"
picks.excerpt: Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney again criticizes Steam's AI disclosure labels, saying Valve is forcing developers to write a political statement that the hate mob uses against them.
picks.rationale: The two biggest PC storefront owners disagree over Steam's AI disclosure labels, which every developer shipping with AI has to fill in. This is a new statement on store policy, not a repeat of the Epic launcher or AI-first stories.

picks.title: Future? No Thanks! dev removes AI-generated voices from game and offers refunds to players who feel "betrayed"
picks.excerpt: Open world ecosatire Future? No Thanks! has been updated to replace some genAI voices, with developer Molleindustria also offering refunds to upset players.
picks.rationale: This is a follow-up with a new event: the developer shipped a patch that replaces the gen-AI voices and offered refunds, so it shows what AI backlash actually costs a studio.

picks.title: SonicFox, Forever A Real One, Pulls Out Of Event That Used Gen AI
picks.excerpt: “I’m a forgiving person. … However there are still consequences to said actions that will prompt me not to attend”
picks.rationale: A top fighting-game pro withdrew from NexCon because the event used gen AI. Event organizers are now paying a concrete cost for AI-made promo material. Gen AI is the core of the story, NexCon has no history entry, and it adds a fifth distinct outlet.

https://www.rockpapershotgun.com/future-.new_action: Molleindustria shipped a game update replacing the gen-AI voices and opened refunds for upset players. The 10-22 card covered only the creator's statement on why he used AI.
